title: The flag that fell from the sky
episode: Why Every Nordic Flag Copies Denmark
description: In legend, the Danish flag fell from the sky in 1219 as King Valdemar II’s army fought at Lyndanise, as Tallinn was then called, and the Danes won. The Danish King’s Garden on Toompea marks where it is said to have landed.

title: Tallinn in 1939
episode: Tallinn Before and Now (1939) Restored and Colorized
description: Footage of Tallinn in 1939, restored and colorized. On March 9, 1944, a Soviet air raid burned much of the city. The bombed buildings on Harju Street, at the edge of the old town, were never rebuilt and are now a small park.
